here, what is the meaning of 0.028, 0.014?
It means second?
Actually I want tts engine of which inference time is less than 1s.
But according to my test, the inference time is in 1.1s-1.8s for Chinese sentence(20-25 characters) on RTX 3090 gpu besides of bert generation time of reference audio.
any methods to improve this?
